changes.en: cropped to one inner ear (rat C, ear C1) and converted from the original NRRD/NIfTI data to DICOM; temporal bone, stapes and inner-ear labels registered as segment masks; in build 708 each structure is also registered individually as a child segment (under bone: temporal bone 3,389,699 and stapes 3,509; under contrast: bony labyrinth 455,858, cochlear nerve + spiral ganglion 9,857, cochlear nerve 20,538), so each parent segment's own display is fully subtracted by its children; 3D reconstruction and rendering in this app
changes.ja: 元の NRRD/NIfTI 形式データから片側の内耳（個体CのC1）を切り出して DICOM に変換、側頭骨・あぶみ骨と内耳ラベルをセグメントのマスクとして登録、build 708 の子セグメントで各構造を個別登録（骨の子：側頭骨3,389,699／あぶみ骨3,509、造影領域の子：骨迷路455,858／蝸牛神経・ラセン神経節9,857／蝸牛神経20,538。親セグメントの表示は子の差し引きで0になる）、本アプリで3D再構成
